quotes.text: Sit on the end of an exercise bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Rest the weights on their ends on your thighs.

quotes.text: At the of your set, either lower the weights to the floor or, with your arms bent, just sit back up and return to your starting position. Alternatively, if you have spotters nearby, allow them to take the weights from you.
